name: ukrainealarm-tray-app
description: Cross-platform tray app for Ukrainian air-raid (drone/missile) alerts, with per-region selection, notifications, sound and colour-coded tray icon.

scripts.assets: npm run icons && npm run sounds
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.package: npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.package:linux: npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.package:win: npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:mac: npm run clean:release && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
